cefrAlignment: Matches B1 'can briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions'; the language (I think, because, for example, the main reason is) and topics are everyday and concrete.
examFidelity: TOEIC Respond to questions (3 s prep; 15/15/30 s), TOEIC Express an opinion (45 s prep / 60 s) and TOEFL interview (45 s, no prep) all match exams.ts and the official ETS timings.
learnerOutcome: Can state an opinion in the first sentence and support it with a relevant reason and a personal example, sized to 15, 30 or 60 seconds, while avoiding I'm agree and According to me.
